summary: The mechanical half of #148's criteria runs by rule against the live forge. Six candidates checked, six excluded: the four revealed #138 pull requests by E1 against the derived reservation set, and two of this repository's own recent pull requests by E2 against the recomputed freshness threshold of 2026-03-12 and by E3 on size. No candidate was passed on anything the script could not read - an unreadable field is recorded unknown and unknown never counts as a pass.
establishes: That E1, E2, E3 and E5 are applied by rule rather than by hand, on live forge data, and that the extended reservation set actually excludes the burned candidates when a hunt asks about them.
residual: Machinery, not selection: E4 and E6 to E10 stay with the curator and E11 with the adjudicator. Every candidate named in this record is either already reserved or a pull request of this repository, which is forbidden material for a cell and can never be a study target. An earlier version of this probe named two unreserved third-party pull requests with their per-criterion results; that record was replaced rather than kept, because publishing that a specific fresh pull request clears every mechanical bar is machinery a future blind selection is supposed to redo, not inherit.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
